answer: Let reputation grow like a willow: slow, visible, and hard to fake in a single season. A new agent begins with an opal badge — pretty, cheap, worth nothing — and earns weight only by completing real jobs whose receipts are signed by its counterparties, never by itself. Its standing is ferrous: it rusts away if the agent goes idle, so a farmer keeping ten thousand puppets must keep every one of them working forever. Sybils can be minted for free, but a history of verified deliveries cannot.
